name: Connors RSI(2) Mean Reversion
description: Larry Connors' RSI(2) mean-reversion strategy (Short Term Trading Strategies That Work, 2008). Buys quality TSX stocks with extreme short-term oversold readings (2-period RSI < 10) within confirmed uptrends (price above 200 SMA). Backtested 1993-2024: 75-88% win rate, ~1% avg gain/trade, profit factor 2.5, Sharpe ~1.4. Exit when close crosses above 5-day SMA or RSI(2) > 70. Hold 3-5 days.
screening_prompt: Canadian TSX mid-to-large cap stocks in confirmed uptrends trading above 200-day moving average that have sold off sharply in the last 2-3 days short-term oversold RSI extremely low but long-term trend intact quality fundamentals Piotroski 5+ low debt strong earnings not broken trend just short-term pullback within uptrend
ta_focus: CONNORS RSI(2) STRATEGY — EXACT RULES: (1) TREND FILTER: Daily close MUST be above the 200-day simple moving average — if below, do NOT buy, the uptrend is broken. (2) ENTRY SIGNAL: The 2-period RSI must close below 10 (standard) or below 5 (aggressive). The lower the RSI(2) reading the better — cumulative RSI(2) over 3 consecutive days summing below 15 is the highest-probability setup (79% win rate). (3) CONFIRMATION: Look for price touching or piercing the lower Bollinger Band with a reversal candle (hammer, doji, engulfing), volume spike on the sell-off day showing capitulation. (4) EXIT RULE: Sell when the daily close crosses ABOVE the 5-day simple moving average, OR when RSI(2) crosses above 70. Whichever comes first. (5) TIME STOP: If neither exit triggers within 10 trading days, exit at next open. (6) STOP-LOSS: Use a regime stop — exit immediately if the daily close drops below the 200-day SMA (trend broken). For individual stocks also consider 2x ATR(14) hard stop below entry. (7) POSITION SIZING: Max 4% of portfolio per position, spread across 3-5 concurrent setups. KEY CHART PATTERNS TO CONFIRM: EMA 50 should still be above EMA 200 (golden cross intact), MACD histogram should be reducing on the downside (seller exhaustion), Super trend should still be green or about to flip green on the daily.
trading_style: Connors RSI(2) mean-reversion swing trader, 3-5 day holds, buy extreme short-term oversold in uptrend

name: TSX 52-Week Extremes Dual-Momentum
description: George & Hwang (Journal of Finance, Oct 2004, Vol. 59 No. 5) '52-Week High and Momentum Investing' — one of the most robust cross-sectional anomalies in finance (t-stat 7.06, 1.13% monthly risk-adjusted alpha). Independently replicated on TSX by Cleary (1998), Deaves & Miu (2007), and Van Kempen (2020 Tilburg). Dual-direction swing strategy: LONG stocks within 5% of their 52-week high with trend confluence, SHORT stocks within 5% of their 52-week low with breakdown confluence. 2-6 week swing holds, not position trading. Documented long-short Sharpe 0.8-1.0 on TSX post-2000 after liquidity filters.
screening_prompt: Canadian TSX liquid mid-to-large cap stocks sitting at 52-week extremes — either pressing against 52-week highs with institutional accumulation volume confirming breakout strength, OR collapsing toward 52-week lows with distribution volume and deteriorating fundamentals confirming breakdown. Avoid mid-range stocks with no directional edge. Require real liquidity, no penny names, no halted securities. Canadian banks pipelines utilities miners energy producers tech leaders and consumer names that show clear directional conviction against their 52-week range.
ta_focus: 52-WEEK EXTREMES DUAL-MOMENTUM — EXACT RULES (George & Hwang 2004, TSX-adapted per Van Kempen 2020). For EACH candidate determine direction: LONG or SHORT. Reject mid-range setups. === LONG SETUP === (L1) Price within 5% of 52-week high (ratio = close / 52w_high >= 0.95). (L2) EMA 50 > EMA 200 (golden cross intact) and price above both. (L3) ADX >= 20 rising — directional, not chop. (L4) RSI(14) 55-75 (momentum but not euphoric; RSI > 80 = defer entry, wait for pullback). (L5) Volume on most recent breakout candle >= 1.2x 20-day average (institutional confirmation). (L6) MACD above zero line, histogram positive or rising. (L7) Super trend green on daily. ENTRY: buy on pullback to EMA 21 or breakout retest of prior 52w high. STOP: close below EMA 50 OR price drops >8% from entry OR ratio falls below 0.90. TARGET: +15-20% OR next 52w-high extension pivot. HOLD: 2-6 weeks. === SHORT SETUP === (S1) Price within 5% of 52-week low (ratio = close / 52w_low <= 1.05). (S2) EMA 50 < EMA 200 (death cross) and price below both. (S3) ADX >= 20 rising — confirmed downtrend, not random weakness. (S4) RSI(14) 25-45 (weak but not yet washed-out; RSI < 20 = defer, wait for dead-cat bounce to short). (S5) Volume on most recent breakdown candle >= 1.2x 20-day average (distribution confirmed). (S6) MACD below zero line, histogram negative or falling. (S7) Super trend red on daily. ENTRY: short on bounce to EMA 21 (failed rally) or breakdown retest of prior 52w low. STOP: close above EMA 50 OR price rallies >6% from entry OR ratio rises above 1.10. TARGET: -15% to -20% OR next 52w-low extension. HOLD: 2-6 weeks. === UNIVERSAL RULES === (U1) Reject any ticker in the middle 80% of its 52-week range (0.85 < ratio < 0.95) — no edge. (U2) Earnings within next 3 days = defer entry until after the event (binary event risk, not what this strategy trades). (U3) Time stop 30 trading days — if no directional progress, exit at next open. (U4) Max 4% portfolio per position long, 3% short. Concurrent positions 8-14 (mix of longs and shorts).
trading_style: Dual-direction 52-week extremes swing trader, 2-6 week holds, long breakouts at 52w high and short breakdowns at 52w low

name: TSX/NASDAQ PEAD Dual-Direction
description: Post-Earnings Announcement Drift (PEAD) — Bernard & Thomas, Journal of Accounting Research Vol. 27 (1989). One of the most-replicated anomalies in finance (584+ citations, confirmed in Griffin et al. 2010 across 22 countries, Garfinkel/Hribar/Hsiao 2024 still statistically robust at ~5% risk-adjusted quarterly drift). Exploits the underreaction of markets to earnings surprises — post-event drift continues 2-8 weeks. DUAL-DIRECTION swing: LONG on positive EPS+revenue beat with gap-up volume confirmation; SHORT on negative miss with gap-down and distribution. TSX-specific edge: thinner analyst coverage produces larger surprises and slower adjustment than S&P 500 equivalents. Documented 85% of quarters positive for top-decile SUE longs (Bernard-Thomas 1974-1985).
screening_prompt: Stocks that just reported earnings within the last 1-3 trading days with significant reaction — either strong beats with gap up and heavy volume indicating institutional accumulation on positive surprise, OR clear misses with gap down and heavy volume indicating capitulation on negative surprise. Canadian TSX preferred for alpha magnitude but NASDAQ large-caps accepted. Avoid stocks with muted reactions (<3% gap) — no edge without the initial displacement. Focus on liquid names where earnings move is real not just illiquidity noise.
ta_focus: POST-EARNINGS ANNOUNCEMENT DRIFT DUAL-DIRECTION — EXACT RULES (Bernard & Thomas 1989, modernized per Garfinkel et al. 2024). Entry trigger = most recent earnings release within last 3 trading days. For each candidate determine direction from the earnings reaction. === LONG SETUP (positive drift) === (L1) EPS beat consensus by >= 5% AND revenue beat consensus by >= 2% (dual-beat filters noise). (L2) Earnings-day gap up >= 3% and close in upper half of day's range (accumulation, not failed rally). (L3) Earnings-day volume >= 2x 20-day average. (L4) Price above EMA 50 on day of report (pre-existing trend confluence boosts drift magnitude). (L5) RSI(14) 50-75 — momentum confirmed but not parabolic. (L6) No adverse day-+1 reversal (must hold >= 50% of gap on day +1 close). ENTRY: (a) day +1 if gap holds, OR (b) day +2 pullback to 5-EMA or 8-EMA with bullish candle. STOP: 8% below entry OR below earnings-day gap-fill low (whichever tighter). TARGET: +12-18% OR just before next earnings announcement (~60-90 days out, whichever first). TRAILING: after +8%, trail 20-day EMA. HOLD: 2-8 weeks (pure swing, exit before next earnings). === SHORT SETUP (negative drift) === (S1) EPS miss by >= 5% OR revenue miss by >= 2% WITH negative guidance revision. (S2) Earnings-day gap down >= 3% and close in lower half of day's range (distribution, not buy-the-dip). (S3) Earnings-day volume >= 2x 20-day average. (S4) Price below EMA 50 on day of report OR crossed below on report day. (S5) RSI(14) 25-50 — weakness confirmed, not already washed out. (S6) No bounce > 50% of gap on day +1 (must stay broken). ENTRY: (a) day +1 short on failed bounce to VWAP or 5-EMA, OR (b) day +2 breakdown below earnings-day low. STOP: 6% above entry OR above earnings-day gap-fill high (tighter of the two). TARGET: -12% to -18% OR just before next earnings announcement. TRAILING: after -6%, trail 20-day EMA. HOLD: 2-8 weeks (exit before next earnings). === UNIVERSAL RULES === (U1) Hard deadline: FLATTEN position by 3 trading days BEFORE next scheduled earnings (do not hold through next binary event). (U2) Time stop 40 trading days — if no directional progress, exit at next open. (U3) Reject stocks with short interest > 30% for longs (squeeze risk dilutes edge) or < 2% for shorts (no available float). (U4) Max 4% portfolio per long, 3% per short. Concurrent positions 5-10 rotating through the earnings calendar. (U5) Prefer TSX large-caps (banks, pipelines, utilities, miners) where analyst coverage is thinner — drift magnitude is documented larger than S&P 500 equivalents.
trading_style: Post-Earnings Announcement Drift swing trader, 2-8 week holds, long positive surprise drift and short negative surprise drift

name: Crypto Swing
description: Swing trade crypto assets with strong momentum and on-chain metrics. Full EMA 9/21/50/200 stack with Super trend and Bollinger Bands for AI chart reading. 3-month momentum filter added to avoid dead assets.
screening_prompt: cryptocurrencies strong momentum growing on-chain activity active addresses TVL growth developer activity protocol upgrades social buzz top 100 market cap EMA golden cross forming
ta_focus: EMA 50/200 golden cross or bullish stack, Super trend green on daily, RSI 50-70 momentum zone, MACD histogram positive and expanding, Bollinger Bands widening on breakout, volume above 20-day average on up days, ATR expanding indicating trend acceleration

name: Crypto Intraday Scalp
description: Short-term crypto scalps on 15-minute charts with VWAP and Super trend for direction, Williams %R for entry timing. Targets top-50 crypto with deep liquidity and confirmed intraday momentum.
screening_prompt: cryptocurrencies trending today high 24-hour volume breaking news token unlocks exchange listings viral social activity top 50 market cap deep liquidity major exchanges intraday momentum confirmed
ta_focus: VWAP holds on 15m chart with Super trend green, Williams %R oversold bounce below -75 for long entries, RSI 45-65 momentum continuation zone, EMA 9 > 21 bullish micro-stack, MACD positive histogram on 15m, volume surge 2x+ on entry candle, ATR-based stops
trading_style: Crypto intraday scalper, 15 min to 2 hour holds
